course.title: Engineering Economics and Financial Accounting
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: Mr. Sagor started a travel agency name 'Eagle Travel Agency' on 1st May, 2018. He invested cash Tk. 2,75,000 and equipment Tk. 80,000 on May 01, 2018. Other transactions during the month are as follows:
May 03: Purchase supplies for cash Tk. 9,000.
, 05: Paid office rent for the month Tk. 10,000.
,, 08: Received cash Tk. 45,000 from customers for travels.
,, 11: Advertising incurred in the Daily newspaper on account Tk. 3,500.
,, 15: Purchase equipment Tk. 50,000 of which paid Tk. 30,000 in cash and balance on account.
,, 18: Withdraw cash for personal use Tk. 6,000.
,, 22: Paid to the Daily newspaper on May 11.
,, 26: Paid payroll for the month Tk. 15,000.
, 31: Supplies used during the month Tk. 5,500.
Required: Show journal entries in the books of “Eagle Travel Agency”

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2019
